_comment2: Michael encounters Javin in the Imperial City. He explains his mission,
_comment3: grants Javin the Sentimental Traveler's Pouch automatically, then offers
_comment4: to join the party. Refusing keeps Michael in place so the player can try again.

speaker: Michael
text: You... you're Javin, aren't you? I'd recognise that face anywhere. Hells, I've been looking for you for the better part of three weeks.

speaker: Michael
text: No, but I know who you are. My name is Michael. I work — worked — as a courier for the Wayfarers' Guild before the roads went to pieces. I was carrying a package addressed to you when the whole route collapsed.

speaker: Michael
text: It's been in my satchel through sandstorms, an inn fire, and a very unpleasant border inspection. I'm just glad it's still in one piece.

speaker: Michael
text: There. Delivered. First successful delivery in six months — I'll take it.

speaker: Michael
text: The truth is... the Guild is gone. The roads aren't safe. And I've got nothing waiting for me here in the city. I heard what you're trying to do about the kobold situation, and — well. I know these roads better than anyone still breathing. I could be useful.

speaker: Javin
text: Are you asking to join us?

speaker: Michael
text: I'm saying I'd rather be useful doing something dangerous than useless doing nothing safe. But it's your call.

prompt: What do you say to Michael?

choices.text: "We could use a guide. Welcome aboard."
"I appreciate the delivery, but this isn't your fight."

speaker: Michael
text: Ha. Alright then. Don't expect me to be cheerful about it — I just mean I'll keep up.

speaker: Michael
text: Right. I figured you'd say that. The offer stands, for what it's worth. I'll be around the city if you change your mind.
